   - Not all antibiotics are beta-lactams (e.g., macrolides, tetracyclines, fluoroquinolones, etc. have no cross-reactivity)
   - Need to know the specific antibiotic name to assess risk
   - Allergic reactions can range from mild (rash) to severe (anaphylaxis)
